method: Deterministic clearing-derived scenes preserve the source 276 objects, then add mixed shared/unique pines, rocks and grass. Twenty percent of generated placements lie on the perimeter for independent camera/shadow visibility. At each tier compare baked reference, instancing-only, and culling+instancing.

limitations: Offscreen serial Apple M1 Max/Metal only; native-window and non-Metal support remain open.
Object-count tiers stress draw submission and scene storage, but do not model gameplay edits or multi-emitter simulation.
Generated geometry uses the existing procedural pine, sphere and cone set; no GLB unique-mesh workload is included.
Shadow dirty/redraw counters confirm deterministic caster invalidation. Captured image review during continuous moving-caster motion was not part of this timing matrix.

measurement_storage.summary: This record embeds per-run median/p95 summaries, paired deltas, run ordering, scene hashes, source/binary provenance, and shadow invalidation/redraw counters.
measurement_storage.raw_samples: Full frame-level dumps were deleted after per-run summaries were extracted; compact per-run JSON summaries are represented here.

implementation_note: The moving-caster benchmark exposed a missing COPY_DST usage on the baked comparison vertex buffer. The buffer is updated through Queue::write_buffer during live transforms; its usage now includes VERTEX | COPY_DST. GPU verification and a 300-frame baked moving-caster route passed.
source_state_note: The release benchmark binary was built from the working tree after the baked comparison buffer COPY_DST fix. git_revision identifies the base checkout; source_and_shader_sha256 and binary_sha256 identify the exact runtime inputs used by every run. The fix was committed after measurement.
